cards.mood: The piece opens with a gentle, intimate storytelling atmosphere that gradually builds into a dramatic, theatrical narrative.
cards.palette: The human voice serves as the sole primary instrument, fulfilling all melodic, harmonic, and rhythmic roles.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Beneath the velvet canopy of night,
He gathered shadows in a heavy chest,
A traveler searching for a spark of light,
Upon a journey, a long and lonely quest.
[Pre-Chorus]
One step forward into the unknown,
One step back where the seeds were sown.
[Chorus]
The whispers call his name in the wind,
Where the silver river turns to gold,
Every secret hidden, every story pinned,
In the stories that the mountains hold.
[Verse]
She wove the seasons into golden thread,
With colors stolen from the morning sun,
By ancient paths where elder spirits tread,
Before the weaving of the web was done.
[Pre-Chorus]
The stars align in a perfect line,
Where the earthly and the holy entwine.
[Chorus]
The whispers call his name in the wind,
Where the silver river turns to gold,
Every secret hidden, every story pinned,
In the stories that the mountains hold.
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
The mountain trembles as the echoes rise,
A sudden truth reflects within his eyes.
[Chorus]
The whispers call his name in the wind,
Where the silver river turns to gold,
Every secret hidden, every story pinned,
In the stories that the mountains hold.
[Outro]
